name: github-release-watcher
description: Watch GitHub repositories for new releases. Remembers the last version it saw and only reports what is new.

state_key.description: Where the last-seen versions are saved

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for the update (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const repo = process.env.REPO; const headers = { "User-Agent": "openclaw-cookbook", Accept: "application/vnd.github+json" }; if (process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN) headers.Authorization = "Bearer " + process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN; fetch("https://api.github.com/repos/" + repo + "/releases/latest", { headers, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) }).then(async r => { const b = await r.json(); return r.ok ? { repo, tag: b.tag_name, name: b.name || b.tag_name, url: b.html_url, published: b.published_at } : { repo, error: "HTTP " + r.status + ": " + b.message } }, e => ({ repo, error: String(e.name) })).then(x => console.log(JSON.stringify(x)))'

node -e 'const latest = JSON.parse(process.env.LATEST).map(x => x.release); let prev = JSON.parse(process.env.PREVIOUS || "null"); if (Array.isArray(prev)) prev = prev[0]; const firstRun = !prev; prev = prev || {}; const found = latest.filter(r => r.tag); const fresh = found.filter(r => prev[r.repo] !== r.tag); const errors = latest.filter(r => r.error); const lines = []; if (firstRun) { lines.push("👀 Now watching " + found.length + " repositories. Current versions:"); found.forEach(r => lines.push("• " + r.repo + " " + r.tag)); } else { fresh.forEach(r => lines.push("🚀 " + r.repo + " released " + r.tag + (prev[r.repo] ? " (was " + prev[r.repo] + ")" : "") + "\n   " + r.url)); if (!fresh.length) lines.push("No new releases."); } errors.forEach(r => lines.push("⚠️ " + r.repo + ": " + r.error)); const seen = Object.assign({}, prev); found.forEach(r => { seen[r.repo] = r.tag }); console.log(JSON.stringify({ hasNews: firstRun || fresh.length > 0, message: lines.join("\n"), newReleases: fresh, seen }))'
if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
